SELECT rc.loan_id, rc.as_of_date
FROM main.risk_classification rc
JOIN main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY rc.loan_id ASC;

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM main.payment_event
WHERE payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC;

SELECT party_id, annual_income
FROM main.person_profile
WHERE annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY annual_income DESC;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM main.payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, o.operating_status
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.organization_profile o ON o.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND o.registered_region = (
    SELECT ou.region_code
    FROM main.organization_unit ou
    WHERE ou.unit_name = '上海分行'
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM main.organization_unit ou
JOIN main.account a
    ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY account_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.sector_name_zh,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.organization_profile op
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN main.industry_sector i
    ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
GROUP BY i.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.fair_value) AS total_fair_value
FROM main.product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN main.wealth_product wp
    ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_fair_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM main.party_relation pr
JOIN main.party p
    ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou
    ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM main.capital_snapshot cs
JOIN main.institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(ABS.balance) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.account a
    ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.account_balance_snapshot ABS
    ON ABS.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) AS avg_principal_overdue_days
FROM main.delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN main.loan_drawdown l ON d.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement a ON l.agreement_id = a.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY avg_principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS 敞口金额,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital AS 敞口占资本净额比重
FROM main.exposure_group eg
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.loan_account_id IN (
        SELECT account_id FROM main.account WHERE institution_id = eg.institution_id
    )
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 敞口占资本净额比重 DESC;

SELECT
    s.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) AS npl_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS npl_ratio
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN main.industry_sector s ON op.industry_code = s.sector_code
LEFT JOIN main.risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
LEFT JOIN main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
GROUP BY s.sector_code, s.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS 合同金额合计
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) AS product_count, AVG(management_fee_rate) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM main.wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level ASC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS 合同金额合计
FROM main.party_relation pr
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    SUM(d.observed_value) AS total_observed_value
FROM main.data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN main.institution i
    ON i.institution_id = d.institution_id
WHERE d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM main.regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN main.institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM main.capital_snapshot cs
JOIN main.institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    d.loan_id,
    d.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM main.delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN main.risk_classification rc
    ON rc.loan_id = d.loan_id
JOIN main.classification_grade cg
    ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_name_zh IN ('正常', '关注')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM main.risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = d.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY d.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS underprovision_loan_balance
FROM main.provision_snapshot ps
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i
    ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY underprovision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    s.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN main.party p
    ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.organization_profile op
    ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN main.industry_sector s
    ON op.industry_code = s.sector_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS violation_amount,
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS total_instruction_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS ratio
FROM main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN main.organization_profile op ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN main.industry_sector s ON op.industry_code = s.sector_code
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on,
    wp.actual_termination_on
FROM main.wealth_product wp
JOIN main.product_holding_snapshot phs
    ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN main.managed_asset ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.actual_termination_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_agreement_count
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.payment_type_catalog ptc
    ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
LEFT JOIN main.organization_unit ou
    ON ou.org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ind_borrower.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    ind_target.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN main.organization_profile op
    ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN main.industry_sector ind_borrower
    ON ind_borrower.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN main.industry_sector ind_target
    ON ind_target.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code <> op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    from_holder.party_id AS from_party_id,
    to_holder.party_id AS to_party_id
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.account_holder from_holder
    ON from_holder.account_id = pe.from_account_id
    AND from_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN main.account_holder to_holder
    ON to_holder.account_id = pe.to_account_id
    AND to_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN main.party_relation pr
    ON pr.source_party_id = from_holder.party_id
    AND pr.target_party_id = to_holder.party_id
    AND pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount
FROM main.payment_event p
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON p.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT
  sm.staff_id,
  COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.account a
  ON a.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN main.account_holder ah
  ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
 AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN main.organization_profile op
  ON op.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN main.industry_sector isec
  ON isec.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN main.service_operator so
  ON so.operator_id = pe.operator_id
JOIN main.staff_member sm
  ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY txn_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    e.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    e.event_date,
    e.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(e.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM main.customer_due_diligence_event_v3 e
JOIN main.institution i ON i.institution_id = e.institution_id
WHERE e.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    ca.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
    ca.status AS 抵押物状态,
    sa.status AS 担保合同状态
FROM main.collateral_link cl
JOIN main.collateral_asset ca
    ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN main.security_agreement sa
    ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE ca.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    so.covered_amount
FROM main.loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN main.secured_obligation AS so
    ON so.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN main.security_agreement AS sa
    ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY so.covered_amount DESC;

WITH loan_inst AS (
    SELECT
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.institution_id
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lb
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        li.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        li.loan_id,
        li.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY li.institution_id
            ORDER BY li.principal_balance DESC, li.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_inst li
    JOIN main.institution i ON i.institution_id = li.institution_id
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rn AS balance_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_industry AS (
    SELECT
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ind.sector_name_zh AS industry_name
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lb
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN main.organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN main.industry_sector ind ON ind.sector_code = op.industry_code
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        industry_name,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY industry_name ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_industry
)
SELECT
    industry_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rn
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY industry_name ASC, rn ASC;

SELECT
    business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
    COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS change_from_prev_day
FROM main.payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    lb.loan_id,
    lb.principal_balance,
    inst_avg.avg_balance,
    lb.principal_balance - inst_avg.avg_balance AS excess_amount
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca2.institution_id,
        AVG(lb2.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lb2
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld2 ON lb2.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id
) inst_avg ON ca.institution_id = inst_avg.institution_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance > inst_avg.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS 担保人数量
FROM main.security_agreement sa
JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN main.collateral_link cl
    ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
    WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
    WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
    WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
    WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
    WHEN principal_overdue_days > 360 THEN '360天以上'
  END AS overdue_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM main.delinquency_snapshot
GROUP BY overdue_bucket
ORDER BY
  CASE overdue_bucket
    WHEN '未逾期' THEN 0
    WHEN '1-30天' THEN 1
    WHEN '31-90天' THEN 31
    WHEN '91-180天' THEN 91
    WHEN '181-360天' THEN 181
    WHEN '360天以上' THEN 361
  END;

SELECT collateral_id, valued_on, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM main.collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, valued_on
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    AVG(lbs.principal_balance) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cash_txn_count
FROM main.organization_unit ou
JOIN main.staff_member sm
    ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN main.service_operator so
    ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN main.payment_event pe
    ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY cash_txn_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    AVG(pp.annual_income) AS avg_annual_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS high_income_ratio
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH acct_inst AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           a.institution_id,
           ah.party_id AS holder_party_id
    FROM main.account a
    LEFT JOIN main.account_holder ah
           ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
          AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
),
rel AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT source_party_id, target_party_id
    FROM main.party_relation
    WHERE relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
),
txn AS (
    SELECT p.payment_id,
           p.amount,
           COALESCE(fa.institution_id, ta.institution_id) AS institution_id,
           CASE
               WHEN fa.holder_party_id IS NOT NULL
                AND ta.holder_party_id IS NOT NULL
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM rel r
                    WHERE r.source_party_id = fa.holder_party_id
                      AND r.target_party_id = ta.holder_party_id
                )
               THEN 1 ELSE 0
           END AS is_related
    FROM main.payment_event p
    LEFT JOIN acct_inst fa ON fa.account_id = p.from_account_id
    LEFT JOIN acct_inst ta ON ta.account_id = p.to_account_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_related = 1 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS related_amount,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_related = 1 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(t.amount) AS related_ratio
FROM txn t
JOIN main.institution i ON i.institution_id = t.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY related_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS 持有贷记卡数量,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS 定期存款账户数量
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.payment_card pc
    ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
    AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
JOIN main.account a
    ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN main.term_deposit td
    ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 定期存款账户数量 DESC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_loan_age_days DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
  FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot
  WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot)
)
SELECT
  loan_id,
  principal_balance,
  quartile_group
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_balance AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(i.sector_name_zh, op.industry_code) AS industry_name,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    LEFT JOIN main.industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
    GROUP BY COALESCE(i.sector_name_zh, op.industry_code)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC, industry_name) AS running_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM industry_balance
),
with_ratio AS (
    SELECT
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        running_balance * 1.0 / grand_total AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT
    industry_name,
    total_balance,
    cumulative_ratio
FROM with_ratio
WHERE cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 未结清借据笔数
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 未结清借据笔数 DESC;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount
    FROM (
        SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY collateral_id ORDER BY valued_on DESC) AS rn
        FROM main.collateral_valuation
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额,
    cl.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
    lv.valuation_amount AS 最新评估价值
FROM main.security_agreement sa
JOIN main.collateral_link cl
    ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN latest_valuation lv
    ON lv.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE lv.valuation_amount > sa.secured_amount * 2
ORDER BY (lv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS 开户机构家数
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY 开户机构家数 DESC;

SELECT from_account_id AS account_id, business_date, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM main.payment_event
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY txn_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 0) AS total_principal_balance
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.home_org_unit_id LIKE i.institution_id || '%'
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.exposure_group eg
    ON eg.group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    AND eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal_balance DESC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) AS security_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) > 1
   AND SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i
    ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    pi.instruction_amount,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name
FROM main.loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement AS ca
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.party AS borrower
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN main.payment_instruction AS pi
    ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN main.party AS payee
    ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM main.credit_agreement AS ca
JOIN main.party AS p
    ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND p.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    ca.target_industry_code,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_product_catalog lpc ON ca.product_family = lpc.product_family
JOIN main.industry_sector ind ON ca.target_industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE lpc.is_working_capital = 1
  AND ind.risk_category = 'EXIT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    lbs.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    inst_avg.avg_balance AS institution_avg_balance,
    (lbs.principal_balance - inst_avg.avg_balance) AS excess_amount
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i
    ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca2.institution_id,
        AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld2
        ON lbs2.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca2
        ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id
) inst_avg
    ON ca.institution_id = inst_avg.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 2 * inst_avg.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.source_party_id
        FROM main.party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
    ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) AS non_related_amount,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.source_party_id
        FROM main.party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
    ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS ratio
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

WITH loan_bal AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
        ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
borrower_bal AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lb.total_principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_bal lb
        ON lb.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
cap AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM main.capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    bb.total_balance AS 余额合计,
    c.net_capital AS 资本净额,
    (bb.total_balance * 1.0 / c.net_capital) AS 占比
FROM borrower_bal bb
JOIN cap c
    ON c.institution_id = bb.institution_id
JOIN main.institution i
    ON i.institution_id = bb.institution_id
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = bb.borrower_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND (bb.total_balance * 1.0 / c.net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS 执行年利率,
    ROUND(avg_rate.avg_rate, 4) AS 所属目标行业平均利率,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_rate) * 1.0 / avg_rate.avg_rate * 100, 2) AS 较行业平均上浮百分比
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT target_industry_code, AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM main.credit_agreement
    WHERE annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
) avg_rate ON avg_rate.target_industry_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND avg_rate.avg_rate > 0
  AND (ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_rate) * 1.0 / avg_rate.avg_rate > 0.10
ORDER BY 较行业平均上浮百分比 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_balance
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot)
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital
    FROM main.capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.capital_snapshot)
),
borrower_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(llb.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN latest_loan_balance llb ON ld.loan_id = llb.loan_id
    JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
exceeded AS (
    SELECT
        blb.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS exceeded_customer_count
    FROM borrower_loan_balance blb
    JOIN latest_capital lc ON blb.institution_id = lc.institution_id
    WHERE blb.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / lc.net_capital > 0.10
    GROUP BY blb.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    e.exceeded_customer_count
FROM exceeded e
JOIN main.institution i ON e.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY e.exceeded_customer_count DESC;

WITH group_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM main.exposure_group eg
    JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm
        ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
        ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
        AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
        ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lb
        ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT
        glb.exposure_group_id,
        glb.group_name,
        glb.institution_id,
        glb.total_balance,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM group_loan_balance glb
    JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs
        ON cs.institution_id = glb.institution_id
)
SELECT
    exposure_group_id,
    group_name,
    total_balance,
    net_capital,
    (total_balance * 1.0 / net_capital) AS ratio
FROM group_capital
WHERE net_capital > 0
  AND (total_balance * 1.0 / net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM main.credit_agreement AS ca
JOIN main.loan_drawdown AS ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS interval_days
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.payment_event pe
    ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) >= julianday(ld.disbursed_on)
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
ORDER BY interval_days ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_balance
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot)
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital
    FROM main.capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.capital_snapshot)
),
borrower_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(llb.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN latest_loan_balance llb ON llb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        blb.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / lc.net_capital AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY blb.institution_id
            ORDER BY blb.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / lc.net_capital DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM borrower_loan_balance blb
    JOIN latest_capital lc ON lc.institution_id = blb.institution_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON i.institution_id = blb.institution_id
    JOIN main.party p ON p.party_id = blb.borrower_party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
)
SELECT institution_name, customer_name, ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        NTILE(4) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ca.institution_id
            ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC
        ) AS quartile
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lb
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    lb.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    inst.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    lb.principal_balance AS 本金余额,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 100.0 / SUM(lb.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.loan_account_id), 2) AS 占比
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.account acc ON ld.loan_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN main.institution inst ON acc.institution_id = inst.institution_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY inst.institution_name ASC, 占比 DESC, lb.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 累计放款金额,
    ld.status AS 借据状态,
    SUM(rs.principal_due) AS 逾期本金合计,
    COUNT(*) AS 逾期期次数
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.repayment_schedule rs
    ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 逾期期次数 DESC, 逾期本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT loan_account_id, disbursed_on, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown
GROUP BY loan_account_id, disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT p.party_id
FROM main.party p
WHERE p.party_id IN (
    SELECT ah.party_id
    FROM main.account_holder ah
    JOIN main.account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN main.term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
)
AND p.party_id IN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
)
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT sm.person_party_id AS staff_party_id
FROM main.staff_member sm
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
  )
ORDER BY sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM main.account AS a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.payment_event AS p
      WHERE p.from_account_id = a.account_id
        AND p.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM main.guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN julianday(current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') < 0 THEN '已到期'
    WHEN julianday(current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN '临期'
    ELSE '常态'
  END AS maturity_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY CASE maturity_bucket
  WHEN '常态' THEN 1
  WHEN '临期' THEN 2
  WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
END;

SELECT collateral_id, COUNT(*) AS link_count
FROM main.collateral_link
WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY link_count DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_type AS 押品种类,
    AVG(cv.valuation_amount) AS 平均评估价值,
    COUNT(*) AS 评估笔数
FROM main.collateral_valuation cv
JOIN main.collateral_asset ca
    ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'BANK_INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY 平均评估价值 DESC;

WITH loan_repay AS (
    SELECT
        repayment_account_id,
        loan_id,
        disbursed_on,
        disbursed_amount
    FROM main.loan_drawdown
    WHERE repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
acct_counts AS (
    SELECT
        repayment_account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loan_cnt
    FROM loan_repay
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) >= 3
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        lr.repayment_account_id,
        lr.loan_id,
        lr.disbursed_on,
        lr.disbursed_amount,
        ac.loan_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lr.repayment_account_id
            ORDER BY lr.disbursed_on ASC, lr.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_repay lr
    JOIN acct_counts ac
      ON ac.repayment_account_id = lr.repayment_account_id
)
SELECT
    repayment_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    disbursed_amount,
    loan_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS 累计放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS 超合同投放金额,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 放款笔数
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    SUM(abs.balance_diff) AS total_diff
FROM (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        a.account_id,
        (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) AS balance_diff
    FROM main.account AS a
    JOIN main.account_balance_snapshot AS abs
        ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
    WHERE abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
      AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
) AS abs
JOIN main.institution AS i
    ON abs.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_diff DESC;

SELECT
    td.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM main.term_deposit AS td
JOIN main.account AS a
    ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM main.payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC, card_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS entrusted_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS self_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.disbursed_amount IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.disbursed_amount > 0
  AND ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) > 0.9
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
  i.institution_name,
  SUM(w.actual_raise_amount) AS total_actual_raise,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN w.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_planned_raise,
  SUM(w.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN w.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completion_rate
FROM main.wealth_product w
JOIN main.institution i ON w.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(w.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN w.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS borrower_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS overdue_loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN main.repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status <> 'OVERDUE' OR rs.status IS NULL THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, borrower_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.party borrower
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN main.party payee
    ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id <> ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM main.loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement AS ca
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS unsettled_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM main.repayment_schedule
GROUP BY loan_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY total_principal_due DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM main.loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot AS lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM main.loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN main.account AS a
    ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM main.loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN main.account AS a
    ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.security_type,
    ca.contract_amount,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name
FROM main.credit_agreement AS ca
JOIN main.party AS p
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT source_party_id AS party_id
    FROM main.party_relation
    WHERE relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT target_party_id AS party_id
    FROM main.party_relation
    WHERE relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
),
product_avg_rate AS (
    SELECT institution_id, product_family, AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM main.credit_agreement
    GROUP BY institution_id, product_family
)
SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS customer_id,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS contract_rate,
    par.avg_rate AS avg_product_rate,
    (par.avg_rate - ca.annual_interest_rate) AS rate_spread
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN related_borrowers rb ON rb.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN main.party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN product_avg_rate par
    ON par.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    AND par.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < par.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id AS 关联方甲方编号,
    pr.target_party_id AS 关联方乙方编号,
    rtc.relation_name_zh AS 关联关系名称
FROM main.party_relation AS pr
JOIN main.relation_type_catalog AS rtc
    ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.credit_agreement AS ca1
      WHERE ca1.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.credit_agreement AS ca2
      WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
  )
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh ASC, pr.relation_id ASC;

WITH member_loans AS (
    SELECT
        egm.exposure_group_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
        SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM main.exposure_group_member egm
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
        ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
        ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lb
        ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE ca.institution_id = (
        SELECT eg.institution_id
        FROM main.exposure_group eg
        WHERE eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    )
    GROUP BY egm.exposure_group_id
)
SELECT
    eg.group_name,
    ml.member_count,
    ml.total_principal_balance,
    cs.net_capital,
    (ml.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS ratio
FROM member_loans ml
JOIN main.exposure_group eg
    ON eg.exposure_group_id = ml.exposure_group_id
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE ml.member_count >= 2
  AND (ml.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.account payer_acc ON pe.from_account_id = payer_acc.account_id
JOIN main.account payee_acc ON pe.to_account_id = payee_acc.account_id
JOIN main.account_holder payer_ah ON payer_acc.account_id = payer_ah.account_id
JOIN main.account_holder payee_ah ON payee_acc.account_id = payee_ah.account_id
JOIN main.party payer ON payer_ah.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN main.party payee ON payee_ah.party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN main.party_relation pr
    ON pr.source_party_id = payer_ah.party_id
    AND pr.target_party_id = payee_ah.party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM main.wealth_product AS wp
JOIN main.product_holding_snapshot AS phs
    ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN main.managed_asset AS ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM main.product_holding_snapshot
WHERE investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    lb.loan_id,
    lb.principal_balance,
    MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN main.delinquency_snapshot d
    ON d.loan_id = lb.loan_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lb.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, lb.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM main.exposure_group AS eg
JOIN main.exposure_group_member AS egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN main.credit_facility AS cf
    ON cf.obligor_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cf.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.exposure_group eg
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.loan_id IN (
        SELECT lbs2.loan_id
        FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
        WHERE lbs2.overdue_principal > 0
    )
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  AND ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    g.guarantee_total AS 对外担保合计,
    l.loan_total AS 自身借款合计,
    (g.guarantee_total - l.loan_total) AS 担保负债差额
FROM main.party p
JOIN (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_total
    FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) g ON g.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
           SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS loan_total
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) l ON l.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND g.guarantee_total > l.loan_total
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    s.staff_id AS 员工编号,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 授信合同笔数
FROM main.staff_member s
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = s.person_party_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = s.person_party_id
WHERE s.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY s.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 授信合同笔数 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    pp.annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS income_multiple
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY income_multiple DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
    so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM main.service_operator so
JOIN main.staff_member sm
    ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
GROUP BY
    p.display_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS staff_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.account a
    ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
JOIN main.account_holder ah
    ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
   AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN main.staff_member sm
    ON sm.person_party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

WITH borrower_repayment AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_due
    FROM main.repayment_schedule rs
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
party_total AS (
    SELECT
        party_id,
        SUM(total_due) AS total_due
    FROM borrower_repayment
    GROUP BY party_id
)
SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS borrower_party_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    pt.total_due AS total_due_amount,
    ROUND(pt.total_due * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS due_to_income_ratio
FROM party_total pt
JOIN main.party p ON pt.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.person_profile pp ON pt.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
ORDER BY due_to_income_ratio DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    lp.product_name_zh AS 产品类别名称,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
    SUM(rs.principal_due) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM main.repayment_schedule rs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_product_catalog lp ON ca.product_family = lp.product_family
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lp.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_days_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_days_count
FROM main.term_deposit td
JOIN main.account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM main.account_holder ah
JOIN main.account a
    ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou
    ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS overdue_count,
    SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN main.account acc
    ON acc.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou
    ON ou.org_unit_id = acc.org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(principal_due) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY loan_id
HAVING SUM(principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(rs.interest_due) AS total_interest_due
FROM main.repayment_schedule rs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY inst.institution_id, inst.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM main.repayment_schedule rs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT loan_id, installment_no, principal_due, interest_due
FROM main.repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE' AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cf.total_limit_amount,
    ld.total_disbursed_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(ld.total_disbursed_amount * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM main.institution i
JOIN (
    SELECT institution_id, SUM(limit_amount) AS total_limit_amount
    FROM main.credit_facility
    GROUP BY institution_id
) cf ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) ld ON ld.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.total_disbursed_amount > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 设定担保金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人个数,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS 保证金额合计
FROM main.security_agreement sa
JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM main.credit_facility AS cf
LEFT JOIN main.status_catalog AS sc
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement'
   AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit_amount
FROM main.credit_facility cf
JOIN main.institution i
    ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY
    cf.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM main.credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称,
       COUNT(*) AS 记录数
FROM main.loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN main.payment_mode_catalog AS pmc
  ON pmc.payment_mode = ld.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 记录数 DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        minimum_holding_days,
        actual_raise_amount,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS grp
    FROM main.wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
)
SELECT
    grp AS group_no,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM ranked
WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
GROUP BY grp
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY grp ASC;

SELECT
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS disbursement_count
FROM main.credit_facility cf
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
GROUP BY cf.facility_id
ORDER BY total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM main.payment_instruction AS pi
JOIN main.payment_mode_catalog AS pmc
    ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY pending_instruction_count DESC;

SELECT
  itc.name_zh AS instrument_name_zh,
  sc.name_zh AS status_name_zh
FROM main.instrument_type_catalog AS itc
CROSS JOIN main.status_catalog AS sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY itc.name_zh ASC, sc.name_zh ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS credit_officer_count
FROM main.organization_unit ou
JOIN main.staff_assignment sa
    ON sa.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_officer_count DESC;

SELECT
    d.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    d.principal_overdue_days,
    d.overdue_principal
FROM main.delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN main.risk_classification rc
    ON rc.loan_id = d.loan_id
JOIN main.classification_grade cg
    ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY d.principal_overdue_days DESC, d.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS undercovered_loan_count
FROM main.provision_snapshot AS ps
JOIN main.loan_drawdown AS ld
    ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement AS ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution AS i
    ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
  AND ps.required_amount > 0
  AND (ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount) < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY undercovered_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) AS total_provision_gap
FROM main.provision_snapshot p
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_provision_gap DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    abs.ledger_balance
FROM main.account AS a
JOIN main.account_balance_snapshot AS abs
    ON abs.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.account_holder AS ah
      WHERE ah.account_id = a.account_id
        AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
  )
ORDER BY abs.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM main.person_profile AS pp
JOIN main.party AS p ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM main.managed_asset
WHERE industry_code IN (
    SELECT sector_code
    FROM main.industry_sector
    WHERE risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
)
GROUP BY asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.credit_facility cf ON cf.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, 客户编号 ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    occupation_code,
    employment_sector,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM main.person_profile
GROUP BY occupation_code, employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, occupation_code ASC, employment_sector ASC;

SELECT status AS card_status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM main.payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, card_status ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.account acc ON pe.from_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN main.payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN main.card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
JOIN main.party p ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM main.payment_event AS pe
JOIN main.payment_card AS pc
    ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN main.card_type_catalog AS ctc
    ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pc.holder_party_id AS holder_party_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cash_txn_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_cash_amount
FROM main.payment_card pc
JOIN main.payment_event pe
    ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY cash_txn_count DESC, total_cash_amount DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号, COUNT(*) AS 发卡数量
FROM main.payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY 发卡数量 DESC, 持卡人编号 ASC;

SELECT
    c.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM main.payment_card pc
JOIN main.card_type_catalog c
    ON pc.card_type = c.card_type
JOIN main.payment_event p
    ON p.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
  AND p.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY c.name_zh
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, card_type_name ASC;

SELECT channel,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
FROM main.payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY channel
HAVING AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, channel ASC;

SELECT
    td.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM main.term_deposit AS td
JOIN main.account AS a
    ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < DATE('now')
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM main.collateral_asset AS ca
JOIN main.collateral_valuation AS cv
    ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS reference_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM main.collateral_asset ca
JOIN main.collateral_link cl
    ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY reference_count DESC, ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    so.agreement_id AS agreement_id,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(dd.total_disbursed, 0), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN main.secured_obligation so
    ON so.security_id = gc.security_id
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        agreement_id,
        SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM main.loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
) dd
    ON dd.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.guaranteed_amount > COALESCE(dd.total_disbursed, 0)
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC, so.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) AS total_covered_amount,
    ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) AS coverage_gap
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.security_agreement sa
    ON sa.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (sa.effective_from IS NULL OR sa.effective_from <= ca.maturity_on)
    AND (sa.effective_to IS NULL OR sa.effective_to >= ca.effective_from)
JOIN main.secured_obligation so
    ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
    AND so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    AND (so.effective_from IS NULL OR so.effective_from <= ca.maturity_on)
    AND (so.effective_to IS NULL OR so.effective_to >= ca.effective_from)
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) < ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS under_provision_count
FROM main.provision_snapshot ps
JOIN main.risk_classification rc
    ON rc.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
JOIN main.classification_grade cg
    ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i
    ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY under_provision_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS borrower_party_id,
    ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance AS principal_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS contract_amount,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance >= ca.contract_amount * 4
ORDER BY balance_multiple DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 多计提笔数,
    SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount) AS 多计提金额合计
FROM main.provision_snapshot ps
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.risk_classification rc ON ps.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date
JOIN main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 多计提金额合计 DESC, 机构名称 ASC, 五级分类名称 ASC;

WITH internal_max AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal
    FROM main.collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
external_max AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external
    FROM main.collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(im.max_internal, 2) AS max_internal_value,
    ROUND(em.max_external, 2) AS max_external_value,
    ROUND(im.max_internal - em.max_external, 2) AS undervaluation_diff
FROM main.collateral_asset ca
JOIN internal_max im ON ca.collateral_id = im.collateral_id
JOIN external_max em ON ca.collateral_id = em.collateral_id
WHERE em.max_external < im.max_internal
ORDER BY undervaluation_diff DESC;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
    SELECT
        cv.collateral_id,
        cv.valuation_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cv.collateral_id ORDER BY cv.valued_on DESC, cv.valuation_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM main.collateral_valuation cv
),
pledged AS (
    SELECT
        cl.collateral_id,
        SUM(cl.pledged_amount) AS total_pledged
    FROM main.collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(lv.valuation_amount, 2) AS latest_valuation_amount,
    ROUND(p.total_pledged, 2) AS total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(p.total_pledged - lv.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM main.collateral_asset ca
JOIN latest_valuation lv
    ON lv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id AND lv.rn = 1
JOIN pledged p
    ON p.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE lv.valuation_amount < p.total_pledged
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

WITH borrower_loans AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_commitments AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(bl.total_loan_amount, 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(gc.total_guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM borrower_loans bl
JOIN guarantor_commitments gc ON bl.party_id = gc.party_id
JOIN main.party p ON p.party_id = bl.party_id
WHERE gc.total_guaranteed_amount > bl.total_loan_amount
ORDER BY gc.total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS 担保债权金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人数量,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证承诺金额合计
FROM main.security_agreement sa
JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM main.person_profile AS pp
JOIN main.party AS p ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    egtc.name_zh AS group_type_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS distinct_member_count
FROM main.exposure_group_member egm
JOIN main.exposure_group eg
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN main.exposure_group_type_catalog egtc
    ON eg.group_type = egtc.group_type
JOIN main.institution i
    ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    eg.group_type,
    egtc.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY distinct_member_count DESC;

SELECT
    egm.party_id AS member_party_id,
    p.display_name AS member_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM main.exposure_group_member egm
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY group_count DESC, member_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS relation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.party_relation pr
    ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
    AND pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
