JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM main.party AS p
JOIN main.party_relation AS pr
    ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN main.relation_type_catalog AS rtc
    ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN main.exposure_group_member AS egm
    ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, 客户编号 ASC;

SELECT
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) AS source_agreement_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) AS target_agreement_count
FROM main.party_relation pr
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca1
    ON ca1.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca2
    ON ca2.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY
    (COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, c.collateral_type
FROM main.collateral_asset c
WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM main.collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
      AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY c.collateral_id ASC;

WITH active_guarantees AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed
    FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
own_loan_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_principal
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT
    ag.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(ag.total_guaranteed, 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ole.total_loan_principal, 0), 2) AS own_loan_amount,
    ROUND(ag.total_guaranteed - COALESCE(ole.total_loan_principal, 0), 2) AS excess_guarantee_amount
FROM active_guarantees ag
JOIN main.party p ON p.party_id = ag.party_id
LEFT JOIN own_loan_exposure ole ON ole.party_id = ag.party_id
WHERE ag.total_guaranteed > COALESCE(ole.total_loan_principal, 0)
ORDER BY excess_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status AS guarantee_status
FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
          ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      WHERE ld.agreement_id IN (
              SELECT ca.agreement_id
              FROM main.credit_agreement ca
              WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
          )
        AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  )
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.wealth_product AS wp
JOIN main.product_holding_snapshot AS phs
    ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN main.managed_asset AS ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown AS ld
    ON ld.loan_account_id = ma.obligor_party_id
JOIN main.delinquency_snapshot AS ds
    ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IN (
      SELECT p.party_id
      FROM main.party AS p
      JOIN main.organization_profile AS op
        ON op.party_id = p.party_id
      WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  )
GROUP BY
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY
    wp.product_name ASC,
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_type AS 担保方式,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS 担保合同笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS 被担保金额合计
FROM main.security_agreement sa
JOIN main.secured_obligation so
    ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY 被担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN main.secured_obligation so
    ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.security_agreement sa
    ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN main.collateral_link cl
    ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    ca.contract_amount
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) > 0
ORDER BY
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM main.exposure_group eg
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm
    ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN main.institution i
    ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE eg.group_type = 'CONNECTED_CUSTOMER'
GROUP BY eg.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) AS total_inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_holding_count
FROM main.product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN main.wealth_product wp
    ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY total_inversion_amount DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN main.wealth_product wp
    ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN main.managed_asset ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id
        FROM main.credit_agreement ca
        WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
    )
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND wp.issuer_institution_id = (
        SELECT ca2.institution_id
        FROM main.credit_agreement ca2
        WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
        LIMIT 1
  )
GROUP BY
    phs.holding_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount
ORDER BY
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC,
    phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_lien_active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60_count
FROM main.collateral_link
WHERE lien_priority = 1
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY over_60_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    f.total_assets,
    f.total_liabilities,
    f.net_assets,
    f.annual_revenue
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.financial_snapshot f
    ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY f.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    institution_id,
    ROUND(tier1_capital * 1.0 / risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS tier1_capital_ratio
FROM main.capital_snapshot
ORDER BY tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(f.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue,
    ROUND(f.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) FROM main.financial_snapshot), 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM main.financial_snapshot f
JOIN main.institution i
    ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE f.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) FROM main.financial_snapshot) > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM main.managed_asset AS ma
JOIN main.institution AS i
    ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating <> ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM main.product_holding_snapshot AS phs
JOIN main.managed_asset AS ma
    ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM main.term_deposit td
JOIN main.account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM main.term_deposit td
JOIN main.account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM main.service_operator so
JOIN main.staff_member sm
    ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'PERMANENT'
  AND so.operator_kind = 'TELLER'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM main.term_deposit td
JOIN main.account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

WITH under_provision AS (
    SELECT ld.loan_account_id AS account_id,
           SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS shortfall
    FROM main.provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
    GROUP BY ld.loan_account_id
),
inst_shortfall AS (
    SELECT a.institution_id,
           SUM(up.shortfall) AS total_shortfall
    FROM under_provision up
    JOIN main.account a ON a.account_id = up.account_id
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_id,
       i.institution_name,
       ROUND(s.total_shortfall, 2) AS total_shortfall,
       ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
       ROUND(s.total_shortfall * 1.0 / fs.net_assets * 100, 2) AS pct_of_net_assets
FROM inst_shortfall s
JOIN main.institution i ON i.institution_id = s.institution_id
JOIN main.financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || s.institution_id
WHERE s.total_shortfall > 0
ORDER BY pct_of_net_assets DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT c.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM main.risk_classification r
JOIN main.classification_grade c
  ON r.grade_code = c.grade_code
WHERE r.classification_basis = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
  AND c.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY c.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT
    ld.institution_id AS institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dl.loan_id) AS nonperforming_loan_count,
    SUM(dl.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.delinquency_snapshot dl
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = dl.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN main.financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || ca.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = dl.as_of_date
WHERE dl.principal_overdue_days >= 90
GROUP BY ld.institution_id
HAVING SUM(dl.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / MAX(fs.annual_revenue) > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS pct
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY pct DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld
    ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY pending_instruction_count DESC, pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS exception_record_count,
    SUM(pm.amount_value) AS exception_amount,
    fs.net_assets AS net_capital,
    fs.total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(pm.amount_value) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets * 100, 4) AS pct_of_net_capital
FROM main.prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pm
JOIN main.institution i
    ON i.institution_id = pm.institution_id
JOIN main.financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || pm.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE pm.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY pm.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY pct_of_net_capital DESC;

WITH
-- 监管报送事项中已逾期未完成记录（按机构统计）
submission_overdue AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_cnt
    FROM main.regulatory_submission_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
      AND completion_date IS NOT NULL
      AND deadline_date IS NOT NULL
      AND completion_date > deadline_date
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
-- 各机构贷款拨备不足的借据（拨备缺口 = 应提 - 已提 > 0）
provision_shortfall AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ps.required_amount,
        ps.recognized_amount,
        (ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS shortfall_amount
    FROM main.provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
),
-- 按机构汇总拨备不足情况
provision_agg AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS shortfall_loan_cnt,
        SUM(shortfall_amount) AS total_shortfall
    FROM provision_shortfall
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
-- 台账平均金额：按机构统计借据平均金额（disbursed_amount）
ledger_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        AVG(ld.disbursed_amount) AS avg_ledger_amount
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    so.overdue_cnt AS 监管报送逾期记录数,
    ROUND(la.avg_ledger_amount, 2) AS 台账平均金额,
    pa.shortfall_loan_cnt AS 拨备不足借据数,
    ROUND(pa.total_shortfall, 2) AS 拨备缺口金额
FROM submission_overdue so
JOIN provision_agg pa ON pa.institution_id = so.institution_id
JOIN ledger_avg la ON la.institution_id = so.institution_id
JOIN main.institution i ON i.institution_id = so.institution_id
WHERE so.overdue_cnt >= 25
ORDER BY pa.total_shortfall DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(cf.cnt, 0) AS credit_facility_count,
    ROUND(gov.exception_amount, 2) AS exception_amount,
    ROUND(gov.avg_ratio, 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM main.institution i
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT institution_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM main.credit_facility
    GROUP BY institution_id
) cf ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS exception_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END) AS exception_amount,
        AVG(ratio_value) AS avg_ratio
    FROM main.governance_control_record_v3
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
) gov ON gov.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS related_target_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_non_related_count
FROM main.related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN main.party p
    ON p.party_id = rtr.subject_id
JOIN main.party_relation pr
    ON pr.source_party_id = rtr.subject_id
LEFT JOIN main.relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY related_target_count DESC, relation_type_count DESC, customer_name ASC;

WITH card_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS cardholder_count
    FROM main.payment_card pc
    JOIN main.account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
op_risk_stats AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_record_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
    FROM main.operational_risk_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 43
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(cs.valid_card_count, 0) AS valid_card_count,
    COALESCE(cs.cardholder_count, 0) AS cardholder_count,
    ors.exception_amount AS exception_amount,
    ors.valid_record_count AS valid_record_count
FROM op_risk_stats ors
JOIN main.institution i ON ors.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN card_stats cs ON ors.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY ors.exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.product_id END) AS on_sale_product_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount END), 0) AS total_actual_raise,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS conduct_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM main.product_conduct_event_v3 pce
JOIN main.institution i
    ON i.institution_id = pce.institution_id
LEFT JOIN main.wealth_product wp
    ON wp.issuer_institution_id = pce.institution_id
    AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
WHERE pce.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY pce.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pce.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise DESC;

WITH asset_stats AS (
    SELECT
        originator_institution_id AS institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS asset_count,
        ROUND(SUM(issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount
    FROM main.managed_asset
    GROUP BY originator_institution_id
),
custody_stats AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_record_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount_sum,
        SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exception_record_count
    FROM main.custody_operation_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    a.asset_count,
    a.total_issued_amount,
    c.valid_record_count,
    c.exception_amount_sum
FROM asset_stats a
JOIN custody_stats c ON a.institution_id = c.institution_id
JOIN main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE c.exception_record_count >= 2
ORDER BY a.total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
